Frequently asked questions

Last updated {{RECENT}}.

What is Kestrel Athletics' return window?

30 days from delivery, free, on unworn shoes in the original box. See returns and refunds.

Which Kestrel shoe is best for a first marathon?

Train in the Velocity X9 at ₹5,499 and race in the Marathon Elite at ₹8,999.

Are Kestrel Athletics shoes waterproof?

No. All three models use quick-draining uppers rather than waterproof membranes, because a membrane traps water once it gets in.

How long does delivery take in India?

Dispatch takes 1–2 business days and delivery a further 2–5 business days. Shipping is free over ₹2,000. See shipping.

How do I choose a size?

All three models fit true to size. If you are between sizes, take the larger one.

What payment methods are accepted?

We accept credit card, debit card, UPI and net banking. Cash on delivery is available on orders under ₹5,000.
